Add border or background utilities on Empty to frame it. Examples With avatar EmptyMedia with the default variant renders arbitrary media — here an avatar for a person-centric empty state. Prop Type Default variant "default" | "icon" "default" The icon variant renders a muted square tile sized for a single icon; default leaves the media unstyled for avatars and images. Empty, EmptyHeader, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, EmptyContent Structural wrappers extending div — they accept standard div props and className for layout tweaks. Was this page helpful?
